## What changed

Describe the focused change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

List the commands, tests, or reproducible examples used to validate the change.

## Data and scientific claims

- [ ] New or changed curve data identify their provenance, units, valid range, and license.
- [ ] Measured, simulated, digitized, and synthetic data are labeled accurately.
- [ ] Benchmark or performance claims include enough configuration and raw results to reproduce them.
- [ ] No private, restricted, generated cache, model weight, or downloaded dataset is committed.

## Software checks

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `pytest`, `ruff check .`, and `mypy photonact` pass locally.
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation agree.
